Empowering children through education since 2017

Tutoring and mentoring for students across Washington, DC.

We pair high-quality academic tutoring with long-term mentoring relationships to help underserved students navigate challenges both in and out of school.

Enroll a student Volunteer Donate

450 students served in 2025 · Seven program locations · Free for families

Our impact in numbers

Consistent relationships, measured over years.

Every student meets the same volunteer tutor each week for the length of the school year, and often for the years after it.

Read the impact report
450 students served in 2025 across our seven Washington, DC program locations.
140 average minutes of tutoring per student, per week, all year long.
100% Northstar students graduate high school and go on to four-year colleges.

Inside a session

Two sessions a week, the same tutor, the same student.

Sessions open with whatever the student brought home that week. The tutor works the problem alongside them, then hands back the pen: the goal is a student who can explain the step, not a page of answers.

  • Assignment review from the current unit
  • Deliberate practice on the gap behind it
  • Written notes home to the family

How it works

One tutor, one student, every week.

01

Enroll or volunteer

Families enroll through the school or community site nearest them. Volunteers apply to a location and are interviewed and background-checked.

02

Matched for the year

Each volunteer is matched with their own student, and that pair stays together for the school year and beyond if both continue.

03

Weekly sessions

Twice-weekly tutoring and mentoring sessions run after school or in the evening, with materials and support provided.

Open source · plain HTML/CSS/JS · no build step

Make your own Aether

Fork it, download it, rename it and put it online free in about five minutes.

01

Get the source

Everything is plain files — no bundler, no npm install, nothing to compile. Fork it if you want to push your own edits, or grab the ZIP if you just want to host a copy.

Fork repository Download ZIP Open on GitHub Single-file HTML

Want one file to double-click? Download specter.html — the launcher, games library, AI, tools and settings are all inlined into a single document that runs straight from your computer. The proxy tab still needs the hosted folder, because it depends on sw.js and bareworker.js.

02

Pick where it will live

  1. Fork the repository with the button above.
  2. In your fork, open Settings → Pages.
  3. Under Build and deployment, set Source: Deploy from a branch, then Branch: main and folder / (root). Press Save.
  4. Give it about a minute. Your copy is at https://YOUR-NAME.github.io/specter/.
  5. Delete the CNAME file in your fork — it points at the original custom domain — or replace its contents with your own domain.
  1. Sign in at dash.cloudflare.com → Workers & Pages → Create → Pages → Connect to Git.
  2. Authorise GitHub and pick your fork.
  3. Framework preset: None. Leave Build command empty and set Build output directory to / — the site is already finished files at the repo root.
  4. Press Save and Deploy. The first build takes roughly a minute and gives you https://your-project.pages.dev.
  5. Add your own domain later under Custom domains.
  1. Open app.netlify.com/start → Import an existing project → GitHub → your fork.
  2. Or skip Git entirely: unzip the download and drag the folder onto app.netlify.com/drop.
  3. Build command: empty · Publish directory: .
  4. Deploy site, then rename it under Site configuration → Site name — you end up with https://your-name.netlify.app.

The Git import screens sit behind a login, so the drag-and-drop route is shown above — both end up as the same static site.

  1. Open vercel.com/new → Import Git Repository → your fork.
  2. Framework preset: Other. Turn the build command off, and set Output Directory to .
  3. Deploy → https://your-project.vercel.app.

Any static host will do — the site is plain files. Upload the contents of the ZIP, not the parent folder.

  1. Keep this structure intact: index.html, assets/, data/, games/, covers/, vendor/, sw.js.
  2. Serve it over HTTPS (or localhost) — the service worker and the proxy tab need a secure origin.
  3. Testing locally? Unzip, cd into the folder and run npx serve ., then open the printed URL.
  4. Works on Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel, Firebase Hosting, S3 + CloudFront, nginx, Apache, or a spare PC on your LAN.
03

Make it yours

  • Name & meta — the <title>, description, OG/Twitter tags and hero subtitle at the top of index.html.
  • Colours — the :root block in index.html and the pinned palette at the top of assets/layout-v2.css.
  • Ads — every slot lives in data/ads.json. Add your own Adsterra zone keys, or set "enabled": false to switch them all off; the ad-block padlock disables itself when nothing is enabled.
  • Games — games/, covers/ and data/zones.json are the library. Swap in your own catalogue.
  • Domain — edit or delete CNAME, then point your host at the same domain.

Use your own Adsterra zones and your own Supabase project before making the site public — the originals are tied to the author's accounts and will not pay you.

04

Run your own proxy worker

The proxy browser loads pages through a Cloudflare Worker — that worker is also what plays the short sponsor break. Deploy your own copy so your fork is independent, then save its address below and this browser will use your worker instead of the default one.

Download worker.js Create a worker
  1. In the Cloudflare dashboard create a Worker and paste the copied code, or deploy this folder with npx wrangler deploy — the settings are already in wrangler.toml.
  2. Add a signing secret for the sponsor break: npx wrangler secret put AD_SECRET. Optionally paste a real ad snippet with npx wrangler secret put AD_HTML.
  3. Copy the address Cloudflare gives you (for example https://your-worker.you.workers.dev) into the field below and press Save.
Preview the worker code 
Open this to load worker.js…

Saved in this browser. To ship your worker to every visitor of a fork, set the same address as DEFAULT_PROXY_WORKER in index.html.

One short break buys 30 minutes: the worker keeps a signed pass cookie, so scrolling a feed or clicking links inside a site does not replay the ad.

Fork it, rename it, ship it. Original project: github.com/immcrab/specter
